boards.title: 10 Late-Night Runs That Explain Occidental College
boards.description: Ten under-21-safe campus and Northeast Los Angeles stops with late hours verified on direct operator or college pages.

cards.title: Tiger Cooler
cards.subtitle: Samuelson Alumni Center, Occidental College
cards.notes: Use the on-campus option when you need a late snack or meal. Check the college dining page for academic-year and holiday-hour changes.
cards.short_summary: Oxy’s latest regular on-campus dining option.
cards.evidence_claim: Occidental lists the Tiger Cooler open until 11 p.m. Monday–Thursday and Sunday/holidays; its grill closes at 10:30 p.m.
cards.access_notes: Academic-year hours: until 11 p.m. Monday–Thursday and Sunday/holidays; grill closes 10:30 p.m. Hours may vary during breaks.

cards.title: Seaside Burritos + Tacos
cards.subtitle: 1958 Colorado Blvd, Eagle Rock
cards.notes: Plan a pickup or dine-in stop on Colorado Boulevard. The restaurant’s location page lists the same late closing time every day.
cards.short_summary: Colorado Boulevard burritos and tacos until 2 a.m.
cards.evidence_claim: Seaside Burritos + Tacos lists its Eagle Rock location at 1958 Colorado Blvd as open 9 a.m.–2 a.m. Sunday through Saturday.
cards.access_notes: Official location page lists dining, pickup, and delivery 9 a.m.–2 a.m. daily.

cards.entity_name: Del Taco — 4903 N Eagle Rock Blvd
cards.title: Del Taco on Eagle Rock Boulevard
cards.subtitle: 4903 N Eagle Rock Blvd, Los Angeles
cards.notes: Use the official location page to confirm the day’s closing time before leaving. It lists midnight most days and 1 a.m. on Friday and Saturday.
cards.short_summary: A nearby drive-thru option with midnight-or-later hours.
cards.evidence_claim: Del Taco lists this 4903 N Eagle Rock Blvd location open until midnight Sunday–Thursday and until 1 a.m. Friday and Saturday.
cards.source_title: Del Taco in Los Angeles, California
cards.access_notes: Official store hours: midnight Sunday–Thursday; 1 a.m. Friday and Saturday.

cards.entity_name: Jack in the Box — 4470 Eagle Rock Blvd
cards.title: Jack in the Box on Eagle Rock Boulevard
cards.subtitle: 4470 Eagle Rock Blvd, Eagle Rock
cards.notes: For very late food, use the drive-thru rather than assuming the lobby is open. The operator lists the lobby closing substantially earlier.
cards.short_summary: A drive-thru listed through 4 a.m. every day.
cards.evidence_claim: Jack in the Box lists its drive-thru at 4470 Eagle Rock Blvd as open until 4 a.m. daily, while lobby hours end at 10 p.m.
cards.source_title: Jack in the Box — 4470 Eagle Rock Blvd
cards.access_notes: Drive-thru is listed until 4 a.m. daily; lobby is listed 6 a.m.–10 p.m.

cards.title: Taco Bell on Colorado Boulevard
cards.subtitle: 1734 W Colorado Blvd, Los Angeles
cards.notes: Check the drive-thru schedule before heading out; it stays open later than the dine-in room and reaches 1 a.m. on Friday and Saturday.
cards.short_summary: Colorado Boulevard drive-thru service through midnight or 1 a.m.
cards.evidence_claim: Taco Bell lists drive-thru hours at 1734 W Colorado Blvd until midnight Sunday–Thursday and until 1 a.m. Friday and Saturday.
cards.access_notes: Drive-thru is listed until midnight Sunday–Thursday and 1 a.m. Friday–Saturday; dine-in closes earlier.

cards.title: Original Ave 26 Tacos
cards.subtitle: 1033 Neola St, Eagle Rock
cards.notes: Make this an earlier late-evening stop rather than a post-midnight plan. The business’s own site lists its Eagle Rock schedule as 5–11 p.m. daily.
cards.short_summary: An Eagle Rock taco stand listed until 11 p.m. daily.
cards.evidence_claim: Original Ave 26 Tacos lists its Eagle Rock location at 1033 Neola St open Monday–Sunday from 5 p.m. to 11 p.m.
cards.access_notes: Official site lists Eagle Rock hours as 5 p.m.–11 p.m. Monday through Sunday.

cards.title: 7-Eleven on Colorado Boulevard
cards.subtitle: 1910 Colorado Blvd, Eagle Rock
cards.notes: Use this 24/7 store for convenience items or hot food when restaurant kitchens are closed. Confirm in-store availability when you arrive.
cards.short_summary: A Colorado Boulevard convenience stop open around the clock.
cards.evidence_claim: 7-Eleven lists its store at 1910 Colorado Blvd in Eagle Rock as open 24/7 and identifies hot foods among its store features.
cards.access_notes: Official location page states “Open 24/7.”

cards.title: 7-Eleven on North Figueroa
cards.subtitle: 5138 N Figueroa St, Los Angeles
cards.notes: Use this Highland Park-area stop for a late convenience run. The official page lists hot foods and says the store is open 24/7.
cards.short_summary: A 24/7 North Figueroa convenience stop with hot foods.
cards.evidence_claim: 7-Eleven lists its location at 5138 N Figueroa St as open 24/7 and includes hot foods in the store features.
cards.access_notes: Official location page states “Open 24/7.”

cards.title: 7-Eleven on North San Fernando Road
cards.subtitle: 2205 N San Fernando Rd, Los Angeles
cards.notes: Keep this as a round-the-clock backup for convenience purchases. The official location page provides the address and explicitly states it is open 24/7.
cards.short_summary: A 24/7 San Fernando Road convenience backup.
cards.evidence_claim: 7-Eleven lists its location at 2205 N San Fernando Rd in Los Angeles as open 24/7.
cards.access_notes: Official location page states “Open 24/7.”

cards.title: Shell C-Store on Eagle Rock Boulevard
cards.subtitle: 4236 Eagle Rock Blvd, Los Angeles
cards.notes: Use the attached convenience store for a late essentials run. The station’s official listing identifies a C-Store and lists 24-hour operation.
cards.short_summary: A 24-hour Eagle Rock Boulevard station with a convenience store.
cards.evidence_claim: Shell lists 4236 Eagle Rock Blvd as open 24 hours and states that the station includes a C-Store.
cards.access_notes: Official Shell listing says “Open 24 Hours” and gives forecourt hours of 00:00–23:59 daily.

boards.title: What the Campus Tour Skips: 10 Places Students Share With Each Other
boards.description: Ten named Occidental spaces for studying, connecting, making, eating, and engaging with campus programs.

cards.title: Academic Quad
cards.subtitle: Between Academic Commons and Johnson Student Center
cards.notes: Use the shade for a reading break or check for a club table, performance, or art installation; programming changes day to day.
cards.short_summary: The central lawn supports study, conversation, club activity, and campus programming.
cards.evidence_claim: Occidental describes the Academic Quad as its campus heart, with shade for study and conversation plus club tables, performances, food trucks, and art installations.
cards.access_notes: Outdoor campus space; check current College event notices for scheduled uses.

cards.title: Branca Patio
cards.subtitle: Johnson Student Center
cards.notes: Settle at the covered patio for an outdoor-style pause near dining, or look for student-affairs gatherings scheduled in the space.
cards.short_summary: A covered patio beside Gresham Dining Hall that hosts campus gatherings.
cards.evidence_claim: Occidental identifies Branca Patio as a covered patio adjoining Gresham Dining Hall and lists student-affairs events there.
cards.access_notes: Some events and reserved uses may have separate access requirements.

cards.title: Green Bean
cards.subtitle: Branca Patio, Johnson Student Center
cards.notes: Bring a reusable cup if you are buying a drink, or check the posted schedule for student-led coffeehouse and open-mic programming.
cards.short_summary: Occidental’s student-run coffee shop also hosts student programming.
cards.evidence_claim: Occidental calls the Green Bean a completely student-run campus coffee shop on Branca Patio and documents student open-mic programming there.
cards.access_notes: Academic-year hours listed by Occidental: Mon–Thu 8 a.m.–8:30 p.m.; verify breaks and event access before going.

cards.title: Academic Commons
cards.subtitle: Mary Norton Clapp Library
cards.notes: Choose a quiet study spot, then use the Writing Center, peer learning, research help, or Critical Making Studio as your project needs change.
cards.short_summary: A library-centered learning hub with study areas and peer, writing, research, and creative support.
cards.evidence_claim: Occidental says Academic Commons offers quiet study, computers, writing and research support, peer-to-peer collaboration, and a Critical Making Studio.
cards.access_notes: Building services and room availability vary; consult the library for current access and reservations.

cards.title: Intercultural Community Center
cards.subtitle: 1501 Campus Road, behind the library
cards.notes: Drop in during posted hours for community-building space, advising, dialogue, or identity-based programming; respect the center’s student focus.
cards.short_summary: A student-centered center for advising, dialogue, programming, rest, and community.
cards.evidence_claim: Occidental says the ICC provides student advising, identity-based programs, dialogue spaces, and physical space for community building, rest, and joy.
cards.access_notes: Posted hours are Monday–Friday, 9 a.m.–6 p.m.; the center prioritizes BIPOC, LGBTQIA+, low-income, and first-generation students.

cards.title: FEAST Organic Garden
cards.subtitle: Below the 1882 Campus Road UEP house
cards.notes: Join FEAST at a listed drop-in session to volunteer or learn, beginning at Bruce Steele Garden; follow the group’s guidance around garden work.
cards.short_summary: A student-run garden used for growing, composting, workshops, and sustainability learning.
cards.evidence_claim: Occidental describes FEAST Organic Garden as student-run, with produce growing, composting, workshops, and teaching and learning activities.
cards.access_notes: Occidental states FEAST doors are open 24/7 to Oxy and wider-community members; confirm volunteer activities through current drop-in information.

cards.title: Fiji Hill
cards.subtitle: East side of Occidental’s campus
cards.notes: Take in the Northeast Los Angeles view while learning about FEAST’s native-habitat restoration; keep distance from wildlife and never handle animals.
cards.short_summary: A 40-acre campus hillside with restoration work, a solar array, and wide Northeast Los Angeles views.
cards.evidence_claim: Occidental says Fiji Hill is the campus high point, where FEAST is restoring 40 acres to native habitat; the site also contains the solar array.
cards.access_notes: Wildlife lives on Fiji Hill; Occidental advises people not to approach or handle injured or sick animals.

cards.entity_name: Mullin Family Studio and Art Gallery
cards.title: Mullin Family Studio and Art Gallery
cards.subtitle: Occidental College campus
cards.notes: Watch for exhibitions and student work, then ask Art & Art History about gallery availability instead of entering instructional shop areas uninvited.
cards.short_summary: A named art facility tied to studio courses, student exhibitions, and sculpture work.
cards.evidence_claim: Occidental identifies the Mullin Family Studio and Art Gallery as a studio-art facility with welding, woodshops, ceramic equipment, and student exhibition activity.
cards.access_notes: Studio and shop access may be limited to classes or authorized users; check with the Art & Art History department.

cards.title: Norris Pollinator Garden
cards.subtitle: Occidental College campus
cards.notes: Pause to observe the native planting and pollinators from a respectful distance; use it as a prompt to learn about campus habitat work.
cards.short_summary: A native-plant garden created to provide food and shelter for pollinators.
cards.evidence_claim: Occidental says the Norris Native Pollinator Garden was established in 2015 and includes California native plants supporting a diverse pollinator network.
cards.access_notes: Outdoor habitat area; avoid disturbing plants or wildlife.

cards.title: Tiger Cooler
cards.subtitle: Samuelson Pavilion, across the JSC Quad
cards.notes: Use the Samuelson Pavilion stop for a quick meal between commitments, and check current academic-year service hours before making the walk.
cards.short_summary: A campus quick-meal venue in Samuelson Pavilion near the Johnson Student Center.
cards.evidence_claim: Occidental identifies the Tiger Cooler as a quick-meal option in Samuelson Pavilion, across the JSC Quad from Johnson Student Center.
cards.access_notes: Occidental lists academic-year service through 11 p.m. Monday–Thursday and Sunday; the grill closes at 10:30 p.m. on those days.

boards.title: Zero Dollars: 10 Hangs That Cost Nothing
boards.description: Ten documented no-admission, no-purchase ways to spend time on campus and at OXY ARTS.

cards.title: Visit the OXY ARTS gallery
cards.subtitle: OXY ARTS, 4757 York Boulevard
cards.notes: Check the current exhibition, then use the screen-reader guide or gallery materials to compare one work with a friend.
cards.short_summary: A free public gallery visit in Highland Park.
cards.evidence_claim: OXY ARTS states that all events and programming are free and open to the public; gallery visits are available during exhibition hours.
cards.access_notes: Gallery hours are listed as Tuesday–Saturday, 11 a.m.–4 p.m., when exhibitions are on view; confirm the current exhibition before going.

cards.title: Go to an OXY ARTS public program
cards.subtitle: OXY ARTS, 4757 York Boulevard
cards.notes: Look at the program listing together and choose a talk, gathering, or other public program that fits your schedule.
cards.short_summary: Public arts programming with no admission charge.
cards.evidence_claim: OXY ARTS states that all events and programming are free and open to the public.
cards.access_notes: Registration is not required unless an individual event indicates otherwise.

cards.title: Attend an OXY ARTS performance
cards.subtitle: OXY ARTS, 4757 York Boulevard
cards.notes: Use the current listings to pick a performance, arrive ready to listen, and leave time afterward to talk through it.
cards.short_summary: A free performance option when scheduled.
cards.evidence_claim: Occidental describes OXY ARTS performances as free and open to the community.
cards.access_notes: Program timing and location vary; consult OXY ARTS listings before attending.

cards.title: Catch an OXY ARTS film screening
cards.subtitle: OXY ARTS, 4757 York Boulevard
cards.notes: Watch the calendar for a screening, then make it a low-key group plan by meeting before the program starts.
cards.short_summary: Free community film programming when offered.
cards.evidence_claim: Occidental describes OXY ARTS film screenings as free and open to the community.
cards.access_notes: Screenings are program-dependent; verify date and venue through OXY ARTS before travel.

cards.title: Join an OXY ARTS workshop
cards.subtitle: OXY ARTS, 4757 York Boulevard
cards.notes: Choose a workshop from the public program schedule and go with someone who is up for making or discussing art.
cards.short_summary: Free public workshops through OXY ARTS.
cards.evidence_claim: Occidental describes OXY ARTS workshops as free and open to the community.
cards.access_notes: Some individual programs may have their own instructions; check the listing before attending.

cards.title: Read in the Ahmanson Reading Room
cards.subtitle: Academic Commons, second floor
cards.notes: Bring a friend and settle into quiet reading, or page through older La Encina yearbooks available in the room.
cards.short_summary: A named quiet-study room with Oxy history close at hand.
cards.evidence_claim: The Academic Commons lists the Ahmanson Reading Room as a quiet-study space, and La Encina invites visitors to peruse older yearbooks there.
cards.access_notes: No library account is needed to enter the Academic Commons during public visitor hours, Monday–Friday, 9 a.m.–5 p.m.

cards.title: Settle into the Jeffers Room
cards.subtitle: Academic Commons, second floor Hunt Wing
cards.notes: Use this quiet room for a shared reading sprint, then step outside afterward to compare notes or swap recommendations.
cards.short_summary: A designated quiet-study room in the library.
cards.evidence_claim: Occidental lists the Jeffers Room as a quiet-study space in the Academic Commons.
cards.access_notes: No library account is needed to enter the Academic Commons during public visitor hours, Monday–Friday, 9 a.m.–5 p.m.

cards.title: Read together in the L.A. Reading Room
cards.subtitle: Academic Commons, third floor Hunt Wing
cards.notes: Pick a chapter, article, or poem to read quietly, then use a nearby common area for a short conversation afterward.
cards.short_summary: A named third-floor quiet-study destination.
cards.evidence_claim: Occidental lists the L.A. Reading Room as a quiet-study space in the Academic Commons.
cards.access_notes: No library account is needed to enter the Academic Commons during public visitor hours, Monday–Friday, 9 a.m.–5 p.m.

cards.title: Claim a first-come group-study space
cards.subtitle: Academic Commons, first floor
cards.notes: Bring a small group for a planning session or homework block, and give groups priority when using collaboration spaces.
cards.short_summary: First-come collaboration spaces for group work.
cards.evidence_claim: Occidental says groups may use first-floor collaboration spaces on a first-come, first-served basis.
cards.access_notes: No library account is needed to enter the Academic Commons during public visitor hours, Monday–Friday, 9 a.m.–5 p.m.

cards.title: Look through Special Collections exhibits
cards.subtitle: Academic Commons / Mary Norton Clapp Library
cards.notes: Walk through a Special Collections exhibit together and choose one item to discuss; check library displays for what is currently up.
cards.short_summary: Library exhibits and archival material in a public-access building.
cards.evidence_claim: Occidental says the Academic Commons welcomes visitors to take in exhibits created by its Special Collections team.
cards.access_notes: No library account is needed to enter; public visitor access is Monday–Friday, 9 a.m.–5 p.m. Outside those hours, an Oxy ID is required.

boards.title: 10 Blocks Off Campus, One Reason Each
boards.description: Named, documented destinations on nearby York Boulevard, Eagle Rock Boulevard, Colorado Boulevard, Griffin Avenue, and Avenue 58 corridors.

cards.title: OXY ARTS — community exhibitions
cards.subtitle: York Boulevard corridor
cards.notes: Check the current exhibition before heading over; exhibitions, events, and programming are free and open to the public unless noted otherwise.
cards.short_summary: Occidental’s community-based arts hub at 4757 York Boulevard.
cards.evidence_claim: OXY ARTS lists its address as 4757 York Boulevard and states that its events and programming are free and open to the public unless otherwise indicated.
cards.access_notes: Gallery hours are Tuesday–Saturday, 11 a.m.–4 p.m., when exhibitions are on view; closed Sundays and national holidays.

cards.title: Bob Baker Marionette Theater — marionette performances

cards.notes: Look at the theater’s calendar and plan around a listed performance; its York Boulevard home presents shows with handcrafted marionettes.

cards.title: Arroyo Records — browse vinyl

cards.title: Galco’s Soda Pop Stop — soda and candy shelves

cards.short_summary: A family-owned soda, candy, and Italian-deli destination at 5702 York Boulevard.
cards.evidence_claim: Occidental College lists Galco’s Soda Pop Stop at 5702 York Boulevard as a family-owned soda and candy stop with an Italian deli.
cards.source_title: Eagle Rock & Highland Park | Occidental College

cards.title: York Boulevard Park — daylight outdoor pause

cards.short_summary: A Los Angeles Recreation and Parks site at 4948 York Boulevard.
cards.evidence_claim: Los Angeles Recreation and Parks lists York Boulevard Park at 4948 York Boulevard with daily dawn-to-dusk hours.
cards.source_title: York Boulevard Park | City of Los Angeles Department of Recreation and Parks

cards.title: Vidiots — video-store browsing

cards.evidence_claim: Occidental College lists Creature’s Plants and Coffee at 4958 North Eagle Rock Boulevard and describes it as a full-scale plant nursery and coffee shop.

boards.title: Only Happens Here: 10 Traditions That Make No Sense Anywhere Else
boards.description: Ten documented Occidental College traditions, campus celebrations, and recurring community practices.

cards.title: Process through the Quad at Convocation

cards.notes: Watch new students process through the Quad with taiko drumming, then join the community celebration that follows the formal program.

cards.evidence_claim: Occidental describes Convocation as one of its oldest traditions; first-year students process through the Quad to taiko drumming.
cards.access_notes: Campus event; confirm the annual Convocation schedule and guest access with Occidental.

cards.title: Make the iFair rounds
cards.subtitle: Academic Quad, each semester
cards.notes: Walk the Academic Quad during the semesterly fair to meet campus organizations, compare opportunities, and pick up current involvement details.

cards.evidence_claim: Occidental calls the Involvement Fair a long-standing Oxy tradition and says it occurs each semester.
cards.access_notes: The Fall 2026 iFair is listed for September 8, noon–2 p.m., on the Academic Quad.

cards.title: Return for Homecoming & Family Weekend
cards.subtitle: Campuswide fall weekend
cards.notes: Check the annual program for alumni, family, student, and athletics events, then plan around the featured campus gatherings and contests.
cards.short_summary: Oxy’s Homecoming weekend brings its campus community together around shared events and athletics.
cards.evidence_claim: Occidental’s traditions guide identifies Homecoming as an Oxy tradition with Quad activities and athletic contests.
cards.access_notes: Occidental lists Homecoming & Family Weekend for October 2–4, 2026; review the final program before attending.

cards.title: See the Spirit Car Parade
cards.subtitle: Part of Oxy Homecoming & Family Weekend
cards.notes: Look for the decorated cars during Homecoming and photograph the procession from a designated pedestrian area rather than entering its route.
cards.short_summary: Decorated automobiles are a recurring visual feature of Oxy’s Homecoming celebration.
cards.evidence_claim: Occidental documented the Spirit Car Parade as part of Homecoming & Family Weekend in both 2021 and 2023.
cards.access_notes: Timing and parade route vary with the annual Homecoming program; follow event staff directions.

cards.title: Attend Apollo Night
cards.subtitle: Black Student Alliance annual talent showcase
cards.notes: Attend the Black Student Alliance’s annual showcase to support Oxy performers presenting music, dance, poetry, and other talent.
cards.short_summary: Apollo Night is an annual Black Student Alliance showcase centered on Oxy performers.
cards.evidence_claim: Occidental identifies Apollo Night as an annual talent show hosted by the Black Student Alliance.
cards.access_notes: Check the student-life calendar for the current year’s date, venue, and audience guidance.

cards.title: Catch the annual Dance Pro show
cards.subtitle: Student-led spring dance production
cards.notes: Reserve time for the spring production and arrive before showtime to see student choreographers and performers share the stage.
cards.short_summary: Dance Pro is Oxy’s longstanding student-led, student-choreographed dance performance tradition.
cards.evidence_claim: Occidental states that Dance Production has thrived at Oxy for more than 70 years and is student-led and student-choreographed.
cards.access_notes: The production is annual; confirm the current spring performance dates and ticket or entry details.

cards.title: Mark Founders Day on April 20
cards.subtitle: Annual observance of Occidental’s incorporation
cards.notes: Use April 20 to connect campus history with the present; look for official announcements of any current-year celebration or programming.
cards.short_summary: Founders Day commemorates the April 20, 1887 signing of Occidental’s incorporation papers.
cards.evidence_claim: Occidental’s traditions guide calls Founders Day an annual celebration held April 20, the date its incorporation papers were signed in 1887.
cards.access_notes: Annual programming is not specified on the guide; verify any current observance with Occidental.

cards.title: Learn the “Io Triumphe” cheer
cards.subtitle: Oxy athletic and alumni salutation
cards.notes: Listen for the call at an athletics or alumni occasion, and use the official history to understand its long Oxy use before joining in.
cards.short_summary: “Io Triumphe” is Oxy’s enduring cheer and has expanded beyond athletics into alumni occasions.
cards.evidence_claim: Occidental Athletics says “Io Triumphe,” introduced at Oxy in 1905, remains its most popular continuing yell and is used as an alumni salutation or cheer.
cards.access_notes: Use respectfully in organized Oxy settings; the official athletics page preserves the full call and history.

cards.title: Take a finals break at Moonlight Breakfast
cards.subtitle: End-of-semester Quad gathering
cards.notes: During finals, check the campus calendar for this late study break, where senior staff have served pancakes to students in the Quad.
cards.short_summary: Moonlight Breakfast is Oxy’s end-of-semester pancake gathering for students studying for finals.
cards.evidence_claim: Occidental describes Moonlight Breakfast as an end-of-semester tradition in which senior staff serve pancakes to students under the stars in the Quad.
cards.access_notes: Occurs around finals; the exact date, hours, and availability should be confirmed through current campus announcements.

cards.title: Spot the orchid leis at Commencement
cards.subtitle: Occidental graduation-day custom
cards.notes: If attending Commencement, notice the orchid leis worn by graduates and confirm vendor, pickup, and ceremony guidance before planning one.
cards.short_summary: Occidental explicitly describes wearing an orchid lei on graduation day as an Oxy tradition.
cards.evidence_claim: Occidental’s current graduating-seniors information calls wearing an orchid lei on graduation day a beautiful Oxy tradition.
cards.access_notes: Leis are optional and available through a campus-approved vendor; verify current ordering and pickup details.

boards.title: Your First Weekend at Occidental College, Shared as Cards
boards.description: A campus-centered, under-21-safe first-weekend sequence using documented Occidental destinations and services.

cards.title: Start with a Quad lap
cards.subtitle: Friday afternoon · central campus
cards.notes: Use the central Quad as your first orientation loop: notice the academic buildings, then choose one landmark to revisit after move-in.
cards.short_summary: Get a visual anchor for the center of campus before making other plans.
cards.evidence_claim: Occidental identifies the Academic Quad as part of its residential campus and depicts students relaxing on lawns along the Quad.
cards.access_notes: Outdoor campus setting; follow current campus access guidance.

cards.title: Spot Thorne Hall
cards.subtitle: Friday afternoon · campus landmark
cards.notes: Walk by Thorne Hall and save it as a landmark in your map app. Its distinctive exterior makes it useful for getting your bearings.
cards.short_summary: Add an iconic campus building to your mental map.
cards.evidence_claim: Occidental calls Thorne Hall an iconic feature of its residential campus and lists it as a campus location.
cards.access_notes: Outdoor viewing is appropriate; building access may vary by event.

cards.title: Make the Student Center your rendezvous point
cards.subtitle: Friday afternoon · Johnson Student Center
cards.notes: Meet your floor or new classmates at Johnson Student Center, then note where dining, Student Activities, and Student Life are located.
cards.short_summary: Find several practical student services in one stop.
cards.evidence_claim: Occidental states that Johnson Student Center houses the Marketplace, Green Bean Coffee Lounge, Student Activities Center, and Office of Student Life.
cards.access_notes: Service and venue availability may vary; check current campus postings.

cards.title: Have a first campus meal at the Marketplace
cards.subtitle: Friday evening · Johnson Student Center
cards.notes: Use the cafeteria-style dining room to settle in with classmates. Check posted menus and dietary labeling before choosing a meal.
cards.short_summary: A documented main dining stop with rotating food options.
cards.evidence_claim: Occidental describes the Marketplace as its primary dining facility; its new-student guide calls it cafeteria-style dining with daily rotating menus.
cards.access_notes: Food requires a meal plan or other payment arrangement; check current dining hours.

cards.title: Take an evening walk to the Greek Bowl
cards.subtitle: Friday evening · campus outdoor landmark
cards.notes: After dinner, make this outdoor landmark a short destination with friends. Keep plans simple and use marked campus routes after dark.
cards.short_summary: An evening campus walk with a named destination.
cards.evidence_claim: Occidental includes the Greek Bowl among the notable features of its residential campus.
cards.access_notes: Outdoor setting; use normal nighttime safety practices and campus routes.

cards.title: Keep Tiger Cooler in reserve for later
cards.subtitle: Friday night · campus dining
cards.notes: If you need a late bite, check the current listing before heading over. Choose this as a low-key food stop, not a late-night outing.
cards.short_summary: A documented late-evening campus food option.
cards.evidence_claim: Occidental lists Tiger Cooler academic-year hours through 11 p.m. Monday through Thursday and Sunday; grill service ends earlier.
cards.access_notes: Current listed hours: until 11 p.m. Monday–Thursday and Sunday; grill closes at 10:30 p.m. Verify hours before going.

cards.title: Set up a quiet Saturday reset
cards.subtitle: Saturday morning · library
cards.notes: Walk to the library entrance, find the building map, and identify a study area you can return to once classes begin.
cards.short_summary: Locate research and study support early in the weekend.
cards.evidence_claim: Occidental says its library provides services, facilities, and technological resources supporting academic, research, artistic, professional, and community-service goals.
cards.access_notes: Review current library access, hours, and conduct policies before visiting.

cards.title: Pause at the student-run Green Bean
cards.subtitle: Saturday midday · Johnson Student Center
cards.notes: Use the café for a brief check-in with a new classmate. If ordering, ask about current offerings and bring a reusable cup if helpful.
cards.short_summary: A student-run coffee-and-snack stop inside the Student Center.
cards.evidence_claim: Occidental identifies Green Bean as a student-run coffee shop with locally roasted coffee and snacks.
cards.access_notes: Purchases require a meal plan or payment; check current hours before visiting.

cards.title: Walk out to Bell Field
cards.subtitle: Saturday afternoon · athletics area
cards.notes: Add Bell Field to a daylight campus loop and look over the athletics area from public paths without interrupting any scheduled activity.
cards.short_summary: Extend your map of campus beyond the academic core.
cards.evidence_claim: Occidental lists Bell Field among the athletic facilities featured on its campus.
cards.access_notes: Observe from permitted areas; facility access and events vary.

cards.title: End with the Fiji Hill viewpoint
cards.subtitle: Sunday near sunset · east side of campus
cards.notes: Finish the weekend with a calm outdoor check-in at Fiji Hill. Go with companions, stay on permitted paths, and head back before it gets too late.
cards.short_summary: A documented campus viewpoint for a reflective final stop.
cards.evidence_claim: Occidental identifies Fiji Hill on the east side of campus and describes a sunset view from it.
cards.access_notes: Outdoor access may vary; use permitted paths and return before dark.
